text: I will never go to another wedding without these paints. They are the smoothest paints I have ever used and the colors are PERFECT! Such a tiny bit goes such a long way. I cannot say enough about how incredible these paints are. Heather, I need you to make these forever and if you ever discontinue them, I will immediately purchase a lifetime supply. These paints feel more essential than my easel after one use
title: GAME CHANGER
